meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Provisional on release; partially revised with the next quarter's release and revised again later. DBIE keeps the first and the latest version of recent quarters; both are kept.
meta.product: India's overall balance of payments (DBIE report 56)
meta.coverage: Balance of payments, every line of RBI's quarterly table, credit, debit and net
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 56, US$ million. Every line as published, keyed by RBI's outline number. A few lines exist only in some years (finer splits of software, business and financial services, FDI components, FII equity and debt from 2012); their absence elsewhere is the table's, disclosed per series.
